datasets.name: revenue_forecast
queryLines:
WITH actuals AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `Close Date`) AS ds,
         MEASURE(`Closed Won Revenue`) AS revenue
  FROM main.ccg_workshop_cdm.mv_commercial_effectiveness
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING ds IS NOT NULL
),
forecasted AS (
  SELECT * FROM ai_forecast(
    TABLE(actuals),
    horizon => '2027-03-31',
    time_col => 'ds',
    value_col => 'revenue',
    prediction_interval_width => 0.9,
    version => '1'
  )
),
max_date AS (SELECT MAX(ds) AS md FROM actuals)
SELECT ds, revenue AS value, 'Actual' AS series FROM actuals
UNION ALL
SELECT ds, revenue AS value, 'AI Forecast' AS series FROM actuals, max_date WHERE ds = md
UNION ALL
SELECT ds, revenue_forecast AS value, 'AI Forecast' AS series FROM forecasted
ORDER BY 1, 2

datasets.name: c360_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  `Risk Category`,
  `Industry`,
  `Region`,
  `Rep Name`,
  `Business Unit`,
  `Is Stale`,
  `Has Backorders`,
  MEASURE(`Account Count`) AS accounts,
  MEASURE(`Total Annual Revenue`) AS revenue,
  MEASURE(`At Risk Accounts`) AS at_risk_accounts,
  MEASURE(`Revenue At Risk`) AS revenue_at_risk,
  MEASURE(`Avg Risk Score`) AS avg_risk_score,
  MEASURE(`Stale Accounts`) AS stale_accounts,
  MEASURE(`Total Pipeline`) AS pipeline,
  MEASURE(`Escalated Cases`) AS escalations,
  MEASURE(`Backorder Lines`) AS backorders,
  MEASURE(`Avg Product Coverage`) AS avg_product_families,
  MEASURE(`Avg Backorder Pct`) AS avg_backorder_pct,
  MEASURE(`Total Closed Won`) AS closed_won,
  MEASURE(`Total Closed Lost`) AS closed_lost,
  MEASURE(`Open Cases`) AS open_cases
FROM main.ccg_workshop_cdm.mv_customer_360
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: c360_accounts
queryLines:
SELECT
  c.account_name,
  c.industry,
  c.region,
  c.rep_name,
  c.business_unit,
  CAST(ROUND(r.ml_risk_score) AS INT) AS risk_score,
  r.days_since_last_activity,
  c.open_case_count,
  c.backorder_line_count,
  ROUND(c.open_pipeline_value, 0) AS pipeline_value,
  ROUND(c.annual_revenue, 0) AS annual_revenue,
  ROUND(c.total_order_value, 0) AS order_value,
  c.product_families_purchased,
  c.product_family_list,
  r.risk_category,
  r.top_risk_driver
FROM main.ccg_workshop_cdm.customer_360 c
JOIN main.ccg_workshop_cdm.account_risk_summary r ON c.sf_account_id = r.sf_account_id
ORDER BY r.ml_risk_score DESC
